notes: As of September 2026, MVG launched a new ticketshop where selected MVV day tickets and single tickets can be purchased online and added directly to Apple Wallet or Google Wallet — no app or registration required. Subscription tickets (D-Ticket, 365-Euro-Ticket, MVV Abo) remain available via the MVGO app with manual monthly re-add required.
